required_documents.name: Application for Federal Assistance (SF-424)
required_documents.details: Standard application form submitted through Grants.gov.

required_documents.name: Statement of Work and Project Narrative
required_documents.details: Scope of work detailing railway corridor investment and capital activities.

required_documents.name: Budget Narrative and Financial Plan
required_documents.details: Detailed cost breakdown justification supporting requested cooperative agreement funding.

eligibility.summary: Amtrak is the only entity eligible to apply. In North Carolina, eligible entities fitting the organizational requirements may apply.

cost_share.details: No cost sharing or non-federal matching funds are required.

review_criteria.criterion: Work Plan Feasibility and Milestone Schedule

submission_limits: Applicant organizations may submit more than one proposal, provided each proposal is scientifically distinct.
important_notes: Application submission is administered via Grants.gov or the designated federal portal for opportunity FR-AMT-27-002.
SAM.gov registration must be active with valid Unique Entity Identifier (UEI) prior to submission; allow 3-4 weeks for new registrations.
Review all instructions, eligibility requirements, and deadlines published on Grants.gov before preparing submission.
